title: Create V2 detailed design and development plan
goal: Translate the accepted V2 overall-design proposal into an implementation-ready detailed design and bounded development plan
out_of_scope: Changes to V1 normative documents or BL-002
acceptance_criteria: Detailed design resolves entities, SQLite DDL and transactional migration, API contracts, desktop DOM/view contracts, state machines, conflict algorithms, validation, security, rollback, and V1 compatibility
Every V2-REQ-001 through V2-REQ-016 maps to components, APIs/data, UI, and tests without AI or automatic assignment
Development plan defines sequential or non-overlapping implementation packages, file ownership, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and independent review gates

release_controls.execution_window: current V2 detailed-design and approval session
release_controls.rollback_plan: remove unapproved detailed-design proposal files and retain accepted overall proposal
release_controls.observation_metrics: requirement traceability, contract completeness, migration safety, implementation package isolation, reviewer findings, and Release governance results
release_controls.stop_conditions: overall-design drift, ambiguous destructive migration, automatic assignment semantics, V1 incompatibility, or unresolved reviewer finding
